name: TeamCity CLI
description: JetBrains' TeamCity CLI, authenticated by the egress proxy: the bottle talks to its server without ever holding the token.

server.description: The TeamCity server, e.g. https://teamcity.example.com. Required: it's the host the access token is attached to, and the one the CLI talks to.

version.description: The CLI release to install. This feature holds the checksums for the default; another version's are fetched from its own release.

readOnly.description: Block everything but GET requests (the CLI's own read-only mode), so a bottle can look at builds but not start or change anything.

teamcity.description: TeamCity access token, from your profile page (Access Tokens)
